= browser_demo: the fixture of a browser's target
:toc: left
:toclevels: 2
:idprefix:
:sectanchors:

browser_demo is a library that declares native and emscripten, which the tests
of the build place in `libs/browser_demo` of a scratch superproject.

[#browser_demo-hello]
== A greeting

A program greets the name its standard input holds:

[source]
----
include::{examples}/hello.cpp[tag=hello]
----

Given `node`, it prints:

[listing]
----
include::{examples}/hello.expected[]
----

[#browser_demo-page]
== The program of a page

A program for a browser alone is linked, and never run:

[source]
----
include::{examples}/page.cpp[tag=page]
----

[#browser_demo-holds]
== What it holds

browser_demo has {n-examples} example and {n-tests} tests: {n-tests-native}
built natively and {n-tests-emscripten} for emscripten. Among them, {n-linked}
is linked for emscripten and never run, and {n-driven} is driven by a script
that node runs, on both targets. Its headers, {n-headers}, compile alone.
